--- title: "Relative difference in % between median and mean prices" format: html --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` ── Attaching core tidyverse packages ──────────────────────── tidyverse 2.0.0 ── ✔ dplyr 1.2.1 ✔ readr 2.2.0 ✔ forcats 1.0.1 ✔ stringr 1.6.0 ✔ ggplot2 4.0.3 ✔ tibble 3.3.1 ✔ lubridate 1.9.5 ✔ tidyr 1.3.2 ✔ purrr 1.2.2 ── Conflicts ────────────────────────────────────────── tidyverse_conflicts() ── ✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter() ✖ dplyr::lag() masks stats::lag() ℹ Use the conflicted package () to force all conflicts to become errors ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} library(plotly) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Attaching package: 'plotly' The following object is masked from 'package:ggplot2': last_plot The following object is masked from 'package:stats': filter The following object is masked from 'package:graphics': layout ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # SCB data snapshot committed in data/ (regenerate with fetch_and_tidy_lan_data_api.R) brf_lan_tidy <- read.csv("data/brf_lan_tidy.csv") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} #Change the df so that it will be displayed in thousant SEK instead + calculate percentage difference. It shows how much higher or lower the mean price is relative to the median. brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |> mutate(mean_price_mkr = mean_price / 1e6, median_price_mkr = median_price / 1e6, diff_pct = (mean_price_mkr - median_price_mkr) / median_price_mkr * 100, diff_direction = ifelse(diff_pct >= 0, "Mean above median", "Mean below median")) #Arrange the order of the regions after the media price 2025 region_order <- brf_lan_tidy |> filter(year == 2025) |> arrange(median_price_mkr) |> pull(region) #Apply the new region order brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |> mutate(region = factor(region, levels = region_order)) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_lollipop <- ggplot(brf_lan_tidy, aes(y = region, group = region)) + geom_vline( xintercept = 0, #linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") + geom_segment(aes( x = 0, xend = diff_pct, yend = region, frame = year), colour = "grey") + geom_point(aes( x = diff_pct, colour = diff_direction, frame = year, text = paste(region, paste("Median:", median_price_mkr, "million SEK"), paste("Mean:", mean_price_mkr, "million SEK"), paste("Difference:", round(diff_pct), "%"), sep = "
")), size = 2) + labs(title = "Percentage difference between mean and median prices", subtitle = "Relative difference in %", x = "Difference relative to median (%)", y = NULL, color = NULL) + scale_colour_manual( values = c( "Mean above median" = "steelblue", "Mean below median" = "darkorange")) + scale_x_continuous( breaks = seq(-20, 140, 20)) + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = diff_pct, yend = region, frame = year), : Ignoring unknown aesthetics: frame ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in geom_point(aes(x = diff_pct, colour = diff_direction, frame = year, : Ignoring unknown aesthetics: frame and text ``` ::: ::: ggplotly(p_lollipop, tooltip = "text") |> animation_opts(redraw = TRUE)|> animation_slider( currentvalue = list( prefix = "Year: ")) |> animation_button( visible = FALSE )
